extensionDescription.message: Blocks AI-generated misinformation in social media feeds.

popupSubtitle.message: Hides AI-generated misinformation in your feed
popupSubtitle.description: Popup subtitle under the product name.

popupUnsupportedHeading.description: Popup heading shown when the active tab is not a supported site.

popupUnsupportedBody.message: Open Instagram.com or Threads.net to analyse posts.
popupUnsupportedBody.description: Popup body shown when the active tab is not a supported site.

popupUnsupportedDetail.message: $BRAND$ analyses posts on Instagram and Threads. Open Instagram.com or Threads.net to use it, or change the threshold settings from the extension options page.
popupUnsupportedDetail.description: Longer popup explanation, shown in place of the short body when off-site. $BRAND$ is the product name.

popupThresholdHelp.description: Help text under both threshold sliders.

popupHidingActionHelp.message: Blurring keeps the image recognisable; removing hides it entirely.
popupHidingActionHelp.description: Help text under the hiding action select.

popupActionPlaceholder.description: Hiding action: replace the post with a warning panel.

popupActionBlur.description: Hiding action: keep the post but blur it.

popupActionRemove.description: Hiding action: remove the post from the feed.

popupDebugLoggingHelp.message: Off by default. Captions and API keys are redacted even when on.
popupDebugLoggingHelp.description: Help text under the diagnostics checkbox.

popupTextSize.description: Popup select label for the senior-friendly font scale.

popupTextSizeHelp.message: Makes text larger in the popup, the settings page and the warning shown over a hidden post.
popupTextSizeHelp.description: Help text under the text size select.

fontScaleSmall.description: Font scale option: the default size.

popupOptionsLink.description: Popup link to the options page.

optionsTitle.description: Options page heading and document title.

optionsLede.message: Point the extension at your own backend to self-host, or use the hosted service.

optionsBackendUrlHelp.message: Hosted default: $URL$. Use http only for localhost.
optionsBackendUrlHelp.description: Options page help text. $URL$ is the hosted default backend origin.

optionsApiKeyHelp.message: Stored on this device only and never synced to your Google account. Leave blank if your backend does not require one.
optionsApiKeyHelp.description: Options page help text for the API key field.

optionsTextSize.description: Options page select label for the senior-friendly font scale.

optionsTextSizeHelp.message: Larger text is easier to read. Applies to the popup, this page and the warning shown over a hidden post.
optionsTextSizeHelp.description: Help text under the options page text size select.

optionsTestConnection.description: Options page button that pings the backend health endpoint.

optionsReset.description: Options page button that clears the backend URL and API key.

optionsStatusSaved.description: Confirmation shown after a successful save.

optionsStatusTesting.description: Status shown while the connection test is in flight.

optionsStatusConnected.description: Successful connection test. $MODEL$ is the backend's model name.

optionsStatusDegraded.description: Connection test reached the backend but it reported degraded. $CHECKS$ is the raw checks object.

optionsErrorEmptyUrl.description: Validation error: the backend URL field is blank.

optionsErrorInvalidUrl.message: That is not a valid URL.
optionsErrorInvalidUrl.description: Validation error: the backend URL could not be parsed.

optionsErrorScheme.message: Only http and https URLs are supported.
optionsErrorScheme.description: Validation error: the backend URL uses another scheme.

optionsErrorInsecureRemote.message: http is only allowed for localhost; use https for a remote backend.
optionsErrorInsecureRemote.description: Validation error: a non-loopback backend URL used http.

optionsErrorPath.message: The backend URL must not include a path.
optionsErrorPath.description: Validation error: the backend URL has a path component.

optionsErrorQuery.message: The backend URL must not include a query or fragment.
optionsErrorQuery.description: Validation error: the backend URL has a query string or fragment.

optionsErrorPermission.message: Permission to reach $URL$ was not granted.
optionsErrorPermission.description: The host permission request was declined. $URL$ is the backend origin.

optionsErrorSaveUrl.message: Could not save the backend URL: $ERROR$
optionsErrorSaveUrl.description: Storage rejected the backend URL write. $ERROR$ is the storage error.

optionsErrorSaveKey.message: Could not save the API key: $ERROR$
optionsErrorSaveKey.description: Storage rejected the API key write. $ERROR$ is the storage error.

optionsErrorRejected.message: Reachable, but the backend rejected the request. Check the API key.

optionsErrorHttpStatus.description: Connection test got a non-OK HTTP status. $STATUS$ is the status code.

optionsErrorTimeout.description: Connection test aborted after the 8 second budget.

optionsErrorUnreachable.description: Connection test failed at the network layer. $ERROR$ is the thrown error.

placeholderPanelLabel.message: Content hidden by $BRAND$ as possible misinformation
placeholderPanelLabel.description: ARIA label on the warning panel shown over a hidden post. $BRAND$ is the product name.

placeholderHeading.description: Heading of the warning panel when the model gave no short reason.

placeholderBrandLine.description: Attribution line in the warning panel. $BRAND$ is the product name.

placeholderScoreAi.description: AI-generated risk score readout. $PERCENT$ is an integer 0-100.

placeholderScoreNews.description: Misinformation risk score readout. $PERCENT$ is an integer 0-100.

placeholderShowAnyway.description: Button that reveals a hidden post.

placeholderReportMistake.description: Button that reports a false positive.

placeholderReported.description: Button label once a false positive has been reported.

placeholderCloseDetail.description: Button that closes the warning panel's expanded detail view.

placeholderDetailLabel.message: Details about why $BRAND$ hid this post
placeholderDetailLabel.description: ARIA label for the detail view inside the warning panel. $BRAND$ is the product name.

placeholderShownLive.message: $BRAND$ showed this post again at your request.
placeholderShownLive.description: Announced in a live region when a hidden post is revealed. $BRAND$ is the product name.
